name: ZSP_ODM_ASSOC_RULES
description: This table stores the associations rules from ODM AR models.

columns.name: ASSOC_RULE_ID
columns.description: Primary Key Of this table.

columns.name: MODEL_ID
columns.description: model_id of ZSP_ODM_MODELS table.

columns.name: ODM_AR_RULE_ID
columns.description: Association Rule Id coming from ODM AR model.

columns.name: ANTECEDENT_NAME
columns.description: Name of Antecedent.

columns.name: ANTECEDENT_VALUE
columns.description: Value of Antecedent.

columns.name: ANTECEDENT_PROD_TYPE
columns.description: Value will be ITEM/PRODGROUP, if antecedent is asset.

columns.name: CONSEQUENT_PROD_ID
columns.description: Inventory Item Id/Prod Group ID.

columns.name: CONSEQUENT_PROD_TYPE
columns.description: Value will be ITEM/PRODGROUP.

columns.name: RULE_SUPPORT
columns.description: Value of Rule Support, coming from AR model.

columns.name: RULE_CONFIDENCE
columns.description: Value of Rule Confidence coming from AR model.

columns.name: RULE_LIFT
columns.description: Value of Rule Lift, coming from AR model.

columns.name: ANTECEDENT_SUPPORT
columns.description: Value of Antecedent Support, coming from AR model.

columns.name: CONSEQUENT_SUPPORT
columns.description: Value of Consequent Support, coming from AR model.

columns.name: NUMBER_OF_ITEMS
columns.description: Value of Number of Items, coming from AR model.

columns.name: ANTECEDENT_FREQUENCY
columns.description: Value of Antecedent frequency, calculated value.

columns.name: CONSEQUENT_FREQUENCY
columns.description: Value of Consequent frequency, calculated value.

columns.name: ANTE_AND_CONS_FREQUENCY
columns.description: Value of Antecedent and Consequent frequency, calculated value.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).
